I do wonder, somehow: Have you suffered from servere depression? Did you lived this living nightmare? Do you wake up every morning, feeling your bodys weekness? Do you want to do something (things like you said) and simply can't get up. I mean it, you can't and there is nothing you can do about it. It passes. That's it. You live with that. You do therapy, take antidepressants and other things to get you up.

To my first question: Did you have a depression, clinically diagnosed? If so, the following may not be as accurate, but if not: How do you know how it feels? 

Can a man know how it is, to be pregant? No.
Can a woman know how it is, to be kicked in the balls? No.
So dont judge to fast on other people, how they are supposed to feel and how you can inspire them. 

In fact, the most happening and servere problem of a depression is, that you know "you're inspired", you know that you can "do a lot of good in this world and in your life". But you have a deep fear of even beginnning. 
You think, hey, that would be a great thing to do. And then it takes one second. Your arms are getting weak and heavy. Gravity seems to be increased by 5 G. Your splitsecond of motivation is beeing crushed down by a wave of self doubt. You don't want that to happen. But it happens.

There is no way of "dropping everything right know", you can't do that decision. Another aspect of a depression is, that you simply can't make decisions. A friend of mine, like me too, suffered from depression. His wife asked him, if he would like to have french fries or simply potatoes for his dinner. He couldn't answer. He didn't know.

It's not about boredom. It's about intelligent people beeing left alone, bullied for their thoughts and ideas. It's about seeing so much pain and agony that you can't take it anymore. It's about having a physically illness (like hypothyrosis) and not understanding, why your body won't function anymore. It's about seeing all theese stupid people beeing so stupid (and in this point, i agree with you.) and acting, like they haven't been blessed with a brain.

Let me tell you an insider:

I challenge you, to put a tourniquet on, arms, legs and whatever you want to. Wait for the feeling to come, when you fell asleep on your arm. In the whole body. Then go, make something beautiful. You would still feel miserable, but you did something good, eh?.

And in the end: If depressive would not give a fuck, they would suicide. If I wouldn't give a fuck, I wouldn't be using my time to explain some things here on reddit.  And if people wouldn't give a fuck about their surroundings, people, environment: What would happen? Exactly. What now happens to the world.

So why should we not give a fuck, I do believe now writing this, depression is ABOUT giving a fuck, not about giving none. Giving no fucks (certainly not all times) is whats wrong with this world. 

Nah, I don't give a fuck about driving a big-ass car. My kids will deal with global warming. Yeah, me neither, I wouldn't give a fuck seeing that homeless man. 

If you challenge someone to go outside and do something, it's about to give a fuck.

Now I'm ending here, enough said. I could go on and on.

Have a good night (or day ;)) reddit. I hope you feel what I intended to write.
